children: Corvex's revenue rose 6,128% year over year, while its net loss widened 335%, as the Corvex OpCo acquisition added AI platform revenue and a full quarter of operations; higher stock-based compensation and depreciation and amortization also weighed on results.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss attributable to common stockholders”. ³ Reported as “Net loss per share, basic and diluted”.
: Revenue was $5.0M, primarily reflecting the acquired Corvex OpCo business; the company said commercialization is in its early stages.
: AI platform service costs were $2.5M, primarily direct costs of operating high-performance computing equipment in leased data centers.
: Expense increased 13% to $1.3M year over year.
: Expense was $842K, driven primarily by AI cloud business personnel costs, online advertising, events and conferences.
: Launched September 30, offering premium open-source AI models through API integration and an inference engine on automatically scaling infrastructure.
